title: Surreal Cosmic Gathering
description: A vibrant surreal night scene shows a giant cracked moon with a sleeping woman's face in a starry sky filled with lightning and colorful nebulae. Below, a green alien in a yellow robe stands beside a floating green skull on a hill overlooking a gothic town, while four cats and a red mouse gather around a swirling vortex portal on a tree branch in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a giant cracked moon showing a sleeping woman's face against a purple and pink starry sky with lightning. A green alien wearing a yellow patterned robe stands on a sandy hill next to a floating green skull with pink eyes. In the background is a dark gothic town with spires. In the foreground, a red mouse, grey tabby cat, black cat, and orange tabby cat with a blue scarf sit on a branch near a glowing blue and yellow swirling vortex portal, with hanging lanterns on a leafless tree.
